caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional, wedge-shaped object with intricate decorative patterns on its surfaces. The object is predominantly colored in yellow, red, black, light blue, and cream. The main face features two stylized red vases with curved handles, a central leaf or floral motif in red and outlined with black and blue, and two blue vertical forms on either side with radiating black lines above them. At the top corners of the front face are two red hanging objects resembling ornamental tassels, set on a yellow background. Below the vases is a horizontal blue bar, bordered in black. The side of the object displays an abstract, layered motif in red, cream, green and black. The front lower section of the object features a rectangular panel with a red, vertically hatched center outlined in blue and black. The composition is outlined in black ink, and there is a number “18” in the upper left corner of the page.
title: Plate 18: Reading Stand, Llano: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
